official.deadline_note: CHED opens numbered batches within an annual call cycle and publishes each batch deadline on the Call for Applicants page (logged-in users see deadlines per batch). As of 11 October 2026 the page states 'No open SIKAP batches right now' for SIKAP Regular & N; the only batch currently open on the portal is SIKAP-L Batch 5 (legal education, closes 23 October 2026), which is a separate programme. No SIKAP Regular/N deadline is published at the time of verification.
official.application_cycle: 2026 Call Cycle - numbered batches (batch titles follow the 'Batch N ... 2026' format)
official.status_note: Call for Applicants page for SIKAP Regular & N displays 'No open SIKAP batches right now - check back later or browse the other program type' (verified 11 October 2026). The SIKAP-L 2026 Batch 5 (full-time and part-time) is open until 23 October 2026.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Privileges are published as 'Actual Tuition and Fees'; under the DHEI model 'the payment of tuition and other fees shall be through billing method directly to the Delivering HEIs'.
benefits: Master's full-time: Actual Tuition and Fees; Stipend P41,000 x number of months/term; Research Allowance P150,000
Master's part-time: Actual Tuition and Fees; Subsidy P40,000/term; Research Allowance P150,000
Doctorate full-time: Actual Tuition and Fees; Stipend P54,000 x number of months/term; Research Allowance P250,000
Doctorate part-time: Actual Tuition and Fees; Subsidy P50,000/term; Research Allowance P250,000
Tuition and other fees billed directly to the Delivering HEI; financial privileges released to the scholar through the CHED Authorized Government Servicing Bank (AGSB)
eligibility: Teaching or non-teaching personnel employed full-time in a CHED-recognized HEI, or in government agencies/private institutions with a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with CHED (SIKAP-N: at least five years of continuous full-time service in the Sending HEI)
Admitted and will enroll in a graduate degree program within the term of application
Not more than 50 years old within the next six (6) months from the date of application
Cleared of any pending obligations from all previously awarded grants or scholarships, including where the applicant served as team member on a funded grant
Endorsement attested by the Sending HEI/Agency/Institution as part of its manpower development plan, and willing to execute a Return Service Agreement with it
requirements: Nomination by the Sending HEI/agency/institution - there is no direct individual application to CHED
Registration of an account on the SIKAP Management System at sikap.ched.gov.ph
Completion of the in-portal Requirements Form once a Call for Applicants is open
Study programme must be an eligible graduate programme at a CHED-partner Delivering HEI (DHEI) with a signed Memorandum of Agreement (MOA)
Programme must be within SIKAP priority areas
documents: Certificate of Employment with Compensation and Proof of Admission to the Delivering Institution (DHEI)
Approved Study Leave (full-time, covering the entire scholarship period) or Permit to Study (part-time) from the SHEI
Certificate of Clearance from previous grants/scholarships, and NBI Clearance

Medical Certificate of physical fitness from a licensed government physician or SHEI clinic, plus mental fitness certification from the SHEI guidance counselor or a licensed government psychiatrist or psychologist

Transcript of Records (undergraduate and graduate degrees), Return Service Agreement with draft Re-entry Action Plan (REAP), copy of any publication in the past five (5) years (if any), and Certificate of Award (if applicable)
selection_criteria: CHED Regional Office (CHEDRO) screens nominees on eligibility and completeness of documents, ranks them by order of prioritization, validates document authenticity, and shortlists based on ranking and allocated slots; the CHED Regional Director makes the final decision

Regular SIKAP prioritization: (1) teaching personnel with plantilla/permanent positions in HEIs; (2) non-teaching personnel with plantilla/permanent positions in HEIs; (3) personnel with plantilla positions in government agencies, private institutions or other entities with an executed MOU and MOA with CHED

SIKAP-N prioritization: personnel enrolled in priority programs identified by the Commission en Banc; personnel from HEIs with ongoing application for government recognition/permit or COPC; HEI personnel who earned micromasters or microcredits; all others
Preference is given to applicants whose salary grade is below Salary Grade 18 within the same category

Scholarships are equitably distributed among HEIs across the various regions; incoming Master's students who are faculty with salary grade 18 or below and included in the HEI's Manpower Development Plan are given priority
coverage: Tuition and other fees at actual cost, billed directly to the Delivering HEI
Monthly stipend: P41,000 (Master's, full-time) or P54,000 (Doctorate, full-time) x number of months/term
Term subsidy instead of stipend for part-time study: P40,000 (Master's) or P50,000 (Doctorate) per term
No travel, relocation or installation allowance is published among the privileges
application_method: Wait for the CHED Call for Applicants for the relevant programme and batch (visible in the Call for Applicants section after login)

Register/log in to the SIKAP Management System at sikap.ched.gov.ph, choose the scholarship programme and batch, and complete the in-portal Requirements Form (personal information, employment, Sending and Delivering Institution, graduate programme)
Download the Documentary Requirements templates revealed after submission, sign, and upload them back (some fields auto-populate from your profile)
Submit the complete documentary package to the Sending Institution, which screens, validates, ranks and endorses nominees to the CHED Regional Office (CHEDRO)

CHEDRO screens on eligibility and completeness, ranks by order of prioritization, validates document authenticity and shortlists against allocated slots; the CHED Regional Director makes the final decision
Confirm acceptance in writing within 15 working days of the Notice of Award and enroll in the approved graduate programme
official.application_route: Institutional nomination only: prepare documents with the Sending Institution, apply through the SIKAP Management System portal when a batch is open, then the SHEI endorses to the CHED Regional Office - there is no direct individual application to CHED
official.citizenship_residency: Filipino citizenship required; no residency rule published
official.international_eligibility: Not eligible - applicants must be Filipino citizens employed full-time in a CHED-recognized HEI or in a government agency/private institution with a CHED MOU
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Programme must be in the ten CHED TANYAG priority areas (Creative Industries; Health and Welfare; Engineering and Advanced Manufacturing; Digital Technology and AI; Tourism; Agriculture, Fisheries, Forestry, Veterinary Services and Food Systems; Natural Sciences; Energy; Actuarial Sciences and Financial Services; Guidance and Counseling), plus other priority programs Inclusive Education and Forensic Medicine, offered by a CHED-partner Delivering HEI with a signed MOA
official.duration: Full-time or part-time study; the full-time stipend is paid per number of months/term of the approved application term
official.description: SIKAP is CHED's flagship scholarship for teaching and non-teaching personnel of Higher Education Institutions to pursue advanced graduate studies (Master's or Doctorate) in priority disciplines across the Philippines, implemented through the DHEI model with tuition billed directly to the delivering institution and privileges released through the CHED Authorized Government Servicing Bank.
official.region: Philippines (nationwide, Luzon to Visayas and Mindanao)

applicant_utility.summary: SIKAP pays your tuition and fees at actual cost straight to the graduate school, adds a monthly stipend of P41,000 (Master's) or P54,000 (Doctorate) if you study full-time, and gives a research allowance of P150,000 or P250,000 - but only if your institution nominates you, because there is no direct application to CHED. You must be a Filipino citizen, full-time HEI or agency staff, under 51 within six months of applying, cleared of all past scholarship obligations, and enrolled in a TANYAG priority programme at a partner Delivering HEI. If you study part-time you receive a term subsidy (P40,000/P50,000 per term) instead of the monthly stipend, so your household budget has to absorb living costs. Watch the Call for Applicants page: batches open and close with little notice, and as of 11 October 2026 no Regular/N batch is open.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Plantilla or permanent teaching staff at a CHED-recognized HEI who are admitted (or about to enrol) in a Master's or Doctorate in a CHED TANYAG priority field and have their institution's backing
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your HEI is CHED-recognized (OIQAG certified, MBHTE-recognized in BARMM, or a LUC with Institutional Recognition) and is willing to nominate you as part of its manpower development plan
Secure admission (or proof of impending enrolment) at a DHEI whose programme carries a signed MOA with CHED and falls in a TANYAG priority area - check the HEIs & Programs catalogue before committing

Secure the approved full-time study leave covering the entire scholarship period (full-time track) or a permit to study (part-time track), and confirm you are not more than 50 years old within the next six months

Get clearances early: NBI clearance, certificate of no pending accountabilities from previous grants (including team-member roles), the medical certificate (licensed government physician or SHEI clinic) and the mental fitness certification (SHEI guidance counselor or licensed psychiatrist/psychologist)
Prepare your Return Service Agreement and draft Re-entry Action Plan with your SHEI, and gather Transcripts of Records for all completed degrees
When the batch opens, register on the portal, submit the Requirements Form, then upload every signed template document well before the batch deadline
common_rejection_risks: Holding any existing government-funded grant or scholarship - even a Notice of Award without a signed contract - or pending accountabilities as a team member on a funded grant
Endorsement not attested as part of the HEI's manpower development plan, or the SHEI failing to rank/endorse you before the batch closes
Failing to disclose a relative up to the fourth degree of consanguinity or affinity working at the CHEDRO processing your file, or having a relative who is already a SIKAP/HUSAY scholar
Already holding a completed degree at the same level applied for that is not required for your SHEI's vertical alignment, or being enrolled in more than one graduate programme

Being employed and studying in the same HEI (except extraordinary CEB-approved cases and PWDs, solo parents, indigenous group members), or already being on extension of study with poor academic performance
Applying to more than one CHEDRO at the same time, or being a beneficiary of another SHEI faculty/staff development programme
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The published privileges cover tuition and fees, a living stipend (full-time only) or term subsidy (part-time), and a research allowance - no travel, relocation, installation, thesis binding or miscellaneous school fees beyond 'other fees' at actual cost are published, so budget for commuting/housing beyond the stipend, and for all living costs if you enrol part-time (only the term subsidy is paid).
document_audit: The medical certificate issuer is strict: licensed government physician or SHEI clinic only - a private physician's certificate will not qualify
Mental fitness certification must come from the SHEI guidance counselor or a licensed government psychiatrist/psychologist, not the same medical certificate
Study leave must explicitly cover the entire scholarship period with no teaching/workload; a partial or semester-only approval fails for the full-time track
Portal documents are partly auto-filled from your profile - after any profile update, re-download and re-check every PDF before signing and uploading
Every scan must be legible; blurry or pixelated uploads are expressly listed as a failure mode, and late submissions are not accepted
Clearance must cover all previous awards including team-member roles on funded grants, and termination from any CHED/government scholarship for non-completion or breach is disqualifying
alerts: No SIKAP Regular/N batch was open on the official Call for Applicants page on 11 October 2026 - the nearest relevant open window on the portal is SIKAP-L Batch 5 (legal education only) closing 23 October 2026, so monitor the page or log in to check the Call for Applicants section
Batches are numbered and open/close quickly within the 2026 call cycle; a missed batch deadline cannot be cured by late submission
After the Notice of Award you must confirm acceptance in writing within 15 working days and then enrol, or the award lapses
SIKAP-L (LL.M./doctoral legal education via the Legal Education Board) is a separate programme with its own JMC and priorities - bar members teaching law should apply there, not to Regular SIKAP
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Batch opens on the portal, you register and file the Requirements Form, upload the signed documentary set, your Sending Institution screens/ranks/endorses to the CHEDRO, and the CHEDRO validates, ranks and routes to the Regional Director for decision
